# Bird mark (licence not confirmed)

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `bird-source.eps` | The original vector as supplied (8337 × 8337 px preview), a stock "colourful bird logo gradient" template with the placeholder text "LOREM IPSUM" |
| `bird-mark.png` | The bird alone, cropped from the supplied preview, transparent background, 1600 px wide |

**Status: do not use in published media.** The file arrived as a stock logo template. Its licence, its source and whether it may be used as
or near a Government of Alberta mark have not been confirmed. Stock logo templates are often licensed for one end user and forbid use as a
trademark.

Before anyone uses it:

1. Find the source (the stock site and item number) and the licence that was bought.
2. Confirm the licence allows government use in print, video and digital media, and use as a mark if that is the intent.
3. Confirm with the communications lead that a new mark may appear beside the Alberta signature.
4. Record the answers here, with the date and who confirmed them.

The bird is left out of every template and contact sheet in this repo until then.
